name: Catherine Green
bio: Oldest sibling. Married Jeeves Green in 2017. Head barista at Park Bros from when it opened in 2015, competed in latte-art competitions in Rochester. JD lived with Catherine and Jeeves from March 2020 through June 2022. A close relationship — she has been a critical sounding board, including encouraging him to connect with Josh McGrath, and relayed the July 2022 revelation about Bronwyn dreading church.
